issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal) with a void return type, but the provided solution implements orderMeal returning boolean. This inconsistency may confuse students about the expected method signature and return behavior (whether they should return a value or not) and could lead to mismatches with automated tests or grading that expect the UML-specified signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across artifacts. Either change the solution's orderMeal to have a void return type (matching the UML and problem statement) or update the problem statement/UML to indicate that orderMeal should return boolean and document the meaning of the return value. Ensure the template (and any tests) reflect the chosen signature.
